technical.summary: Bullish structure with price above key moving averages and above cloud, but momentum is stalling with bearish stoch cross and weak RSI rising signals, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 85 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and stale trading data (2+ years old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (448), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures energy multinationals, and imminent CPI event (2 days) creates near-term volatility risk despite distant earnings (85 days).

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above SMA 200 and Ichimoku cloud with supertrend bullish provides structural upside bias, and extreme fear sentiment (14/100) offers contrarian entry opportunity into energy sector positioned for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Momentum is collapsing (bearish stoch cross, weak RSI, stochRSI oversold, CMF 0.017) into a macro crisis environment (VIX 448, flat yield curve, rising DXY headwind, CPI event in 2 days), zero fundamental conviction, and no active strategy triggered—entry quality is moderate at best with severe near-term volatility risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish (price above SMA200, Ichimoku cloud, supertrend), but momentum is collapsing into a macro crisis environment with VIX at 448 and CPI event in 2 days. decision.primary_risk: Imminent CPI announcement (2 days) combined with VIX crisis levels and flat yield curve creates severe near-term volatility that will likely trigger stop-losses before structural upside can develop.
